description: Build or parse Markdown (GitHub-flavoured) tables. Build: from an array of objects, an array of arrays or CSV, with column selection / order / renaming, alignment (numeric columns right-aligned automatically), pipe / newline escaping, cell truncation and padding that respects wide CJK / emoji characters; also returns an HTML table. Parse: extract every table from Markdown into headers, alignment and typed rows (JSON). Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/markdown-table

data.description: Rows: array of objects, array of arrays (first row = header unless headers given) or a CSV string

name: markdown_table
title: Markdown Table
